## Description
Briefly describe the change and the rationale behind it.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI / Build script update

## Compliance & Governance Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] My commits follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) standard (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, etc.).
- [ ] My commits include Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO 1.1) sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] **Zero Secret Exposure**: No API keys, credentials, or private secrets are present in code or tests.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass without errors.
- [ ] Linting and formatting checks pass cleanly.
